en.title: 17 killed in two mass shootings in South Africa
en.dek: Two separate incidents resulted in 17 deaths across Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal provinces
facts: 17 killed in two separate mass shooting incidents on 2026-11-16
Six men and three women found shot dead inside a shack near Pretoria
Second shooting in KwaZulu-Natal province left additional dead
Nine people shot dead in Atteridgeville mass shooting
body: On 2026-11-16, 17 people were killed in two separate mass shooting incidents in South Africa, according to Africanews and DW.com.
The first incident occurred near Pretoria where six men and three women were found shot dead inside a shack, as reported by Africanews and DW.com.
A second shooting in KwaZulu-Natal province resulted in additional deaths, with the total fatalities reaching 17 across both incidents.
In Atteridgeville, nine people were shot dead, with The Mail & Guardian and yfm.co.za reporting the incident, and Y WORLD noting nine people killed in the Atteridgeville mass shooting.
The nine deaths in Atteridgeville were reported separately from the Pretoria and KwaZulu-Natal incidents, with Y WORLD confirming the death toll at nine.
Authorities have not yet released official statements regarding motives or suspects in either series of shootings, according to the confirmed reports.
en.context: South Africa has been battling rising violent crime, with these shootings occurring amid ongoing concerns about gun violence in the country, as reported by Africanews.
